days.title: Observe your sunlight
days.description: Spend 15 minutes observing different areas of your living space. Note how much direct sunlight each spot receives throughout the day. This helps you understand where plants can thrive.
days.tip: South-facing windows generally receive the most direct sunlight in the Northern Hemisphere.

days.title: Research beginner plants
days.description: Based on yesterday's light observation, research 3 easy-to-grow plants suitable for your available light and the UAE climate (e.g., basil, mint, aloe vera).
days.tip: Look for plants labelled 'drought-tolerant' or 'full sun' for UAE outdoor conditions.

days.title: Gather your tools
days.description: Organize your starter kit: pots, soil, basic tools, and seeds/seedlings. Clean any used pots with soap and water to prevent disease.
days.tip: Sterilize old pots with a 1:9 bleach-to-water solution to kill lingering pathogens.

days.title: Seed starting 101
days.description: Fill 3 small pots with potting soil. Plant 2-3 seeds in each, following package depth instructions. Gently water until moist.
days.tip: Planting seeds too deep prevents them from germinating; too shallow and they dry out.

days.title: Watering basics
days.description: Check the soil moisture of your newly planted seeds. Water only if the top inch of soil feels dry. Observe how the water absorbs.
days.tip: Overwatering is a common killer of beginner plants; always check soil moisture before adding more water.

days.title: Labeling and light placement
days.description: Label each pot with the plant type and date planted. Place them in the sunniest spot you identified on Day 1, ensuring good air circulation.
days.tip: Labels help track germination times and prevent confusion as seedlings emerge.

days.title: Week 1 review & plan
days.description: Inspect your planted pots for any signs of germination or issues. Reflect on what you learned this week and what you want to try next.
days.tip: Patience is key in gardening; some seeds take weeks to sprout.
